observations.title: Find snow beneath a cold-biome canopy
observations.player_action: Explore newly generated snowy-biome forest terrain or revisit it during snowfall.
observations.outcome: Snow may generate under trees; ordinary warm forests are unaffected by default.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Control when under-tree snow appears
observations.player_action: Inspect enable_biome_feature, enable_when_snowing and filtered_biomes settings.
observations.outcome: Initial generation and snowfall deposition can be enabled independently and specific biome IDs excluded.
conditions: The author's Snow Real Magic/season-mod compatibility list is not proof of every installed-version combination.
